english.note: IELTS within the last three years. English proficiency may also be satisfied by a qualifying degree in a listed country or approved ELS study; central country list governs degree exemption. Central policy additionally requires TOEFL speaking 26/30 for Graduate Teaching Assistantship consideration; the page does not state a new-scale equivalent, so confirm rather than convert.

documents: Official transcripts from every college/university attended
Statement of goals on academic achievements, research experience, career goals and program objectives
requirements.note: Four-year bachelor’s or equivalent required. Undergraduate GPA at least3.0; applicants with graduate education should have3.5 in graduate coursework. Ideal preparation: biology, general/organic chemistry and physics with labs, biochemistry, calculus and advanced biology-area coursework. At least two of three recommendation letters must be faculty with direct academic knowledge. GRE optional; strong scores may enhance application.

funding.note: All admitted students receive a research-assistant stipend and full tuition waiver. Undated published rates are $29,705.76 for PhD students, increasing to $33,348.48 after candidacy. Students obtain/pay their own health insurance and student fees; confirm current rates.
